how: Banya Forrest on Bluewaters Island offers Russian banya steam-sauna sessions with parenie treatments, cold plunge pools and a snow room (about three hours of access per visit).
Banya Forrest on Bluewaters Island includes cold plunge pools in its banya sessions; group ice-bath sessions are also listed at Lah Lah in Zabeel House The Greens.
The Mud House Studio in Al Quoz runs pottery classes (wheel throwing and hand-building), workshops and memberships for absolute beginners up to experienced potters.
Kitesurfing.ae teaches kitesurfing from Dubai's beaches with discovery courses, 10-hour beginner courses and hourly lessons plus equipment rental.

Frying Pan Adventures runs guided multi-stop food walks through Old Dubai (spice and gold souks, Bur Dubai, creekside) and neighbourhood food tours such as Little India and Middle Eastern pilgrimage routes.
Dubai Butterfly Garden is a covered garden housing thousands of live butterflies that visitors can walk through and photograph.
The Dubai Writers' Group (founded 2005) runs a critique group and sit-and-write sessions for amateur and professional writers, welcoming complete beginners.

Courtyard Playhouse is an independent theatre and performing-arts training centre running improv and acting workshops for adults and children; Dubai Drama Group (founded 1984) stages community theatre with workshops.

Alliance Francaise Dubai teaches French from complete beginner to advanced (group classes, private tuition, kids and teens, DELF/DALF exam prep) at Oud Metha and Dubai Knowledge Park, plus cultural events.
Brass Monkey (Bluewaters and City Walk) has pool tables on its upper level for adults, and Wavehouse at Atlantis The Palm lists pool alongside bowling and arcade games.
SeaYou Watersport Center on Palm Jumeirah rents pedalos alongside kayaks, SUP and sailboats; pedal boats are also hired at Zabeel Park and Al Barsha Pond Park.
SeaYou offers windsurfing and stand-up paddle lessons and tours from its Palm Jumeirah watersports centre.
World Cube Association-sanctioned speedcubing competitions are held at Dubai schools and venues (for example the Cube for Change events at Dubai International Academy Emirates Hills).

how: The Sheikh Mohammed Centre for Cultural Understanding in the Al Fahidi Historical Neighbourhood runs Emirati cultural meals, Open House programmes, Jumeirah Mosque visits and talks for visitors and residents.

how: The Sheikh Mohammed Centre for Cultural Understanding runs a Heritage Express trolley tour of the city's oldest neighbourhoods, and Frying Pan Adventures runs guided Old Dubai souk and creek walks.

how: RAW Coffee Company roasts in Al Quoz and runs coffee training (barista and brewing courses, an Art of Cupping workshop at the roastery) but lists no dedicated roasting course.
Tashkeel runs weekly 'Drop-in & Knot' macrame weekend workshops led by a mentor, alongside other drop-in craft sessions.
Tashkeel Nad Al Sheba has a dedicated Printmaking Studio and runs printmaking workshops (block printing, cyanotype); the specific intaglio etching facilities are not itemised on its pages.
Tashkeel Nad Al Sheba has a dedicated Printmaking Studio and Risograph digital printing studio; lithography as a specific technique is not itemised on its pages.
Mushrif National Park has a roughly 50 km colour-coded mountain bike track (green beginner to black expert); a roundup also lists bike rental at Al Qudra and club rides at District One.
SAE University College Dubai teaches animation (bachelor programmes plus beginner and advanced animation short courses and creative camps).
SAE University College Dubai runs games degrees and game-developer short courses, and Futurise lists game design and app-development courses; dedicated game jams were not confirmed.

Star Geeks Robotics Smart Playground at Wafi City runs robotics building and programming for ages 4-12, and Pure Minds Academy teaches robotics, Python and electronics to ages 10-17 at venues including the Museum of the Future.
Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary has three free public bird hides; its species list includes osprey, Eurasian marsh harrier and spotted eagle among flamingos and waders.

The LightHouse Arabia runs free monthly grief support groups at its Raymee Grief Center (after an initial consultation) and lists further community support groups and workshops at its Jumeirah and Dubai Healthcare City branches.

The Dubai Natural History Group runs member field trips that include geology outings (Hatta copper deposits, Rainbow Valley, Buhais Geology Park) and a past fossil-hunting trip; trips are for members only.
Banya Forrest on Bluewaters Island offers massage treatments, body scrubs and parenie therapy; hotel spas such as Talise Spa at Madinat Jumeirah also list aromatherapy massage.

how: Alserkal Avenue hosts one-off baking workshops such as The Art of Phyllo at Piehaus and a bread workshop hosted by Subko during its What the Food festival; no standing artisan bread course was confirmed.
Dubai Islands Beach is described as the city's first official dog beach, with off-leash running and swimming, agility equipment, pet showers and free entry.
The Al Fahidi Historical Neighbourhood and Al Seef heritage district can be walked on a free self-guided route past wind towers, alleys and restored houses, ending at XVA Art Hotel.
